1 · Intro

When to use it.

Without a requisition, the HCM in the employee's current business unit submits the transfer. For staff, HCMs do two kinds: organization transfers, planned within the business unit, and transfers to faculty status.

Use this whenA move is planned within your business unit, or a staff member is becoming faculty.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • Positions can't move between business units. A new business unit needs new positions.
  • A transfer that came from applying for a job is processed by central HR. See Transfer or promotion from a requisition.
  • Open item: the 5-business-day internal posting rule for internal moves is a separate initiative.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: Redwood experience for the Transfer process (24A) (opens in a new tab)

HCM Academy job aid · Transfers and Promotions

Transfer or promotion without a requisition

Use when: A move is planned within your business unit, or a staff member is becoming faculty. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Open Employment Info and choose Transfer.
  2. Select extra sections if pay changes.
  3. Effective date: line it up with payroll.
  4. Pick the transfer type.
  5. Update the assignment fields, then Submit.

Watch-outs

  • Positions can't move between business units. A new business unit needs new positions.
  • A transfer that came from applying for a job is processed by central HR. See Transfer or promotion from a requisition.
  • Open item: the 5-business-day internal posting rule for internal moves is a separate initiative.
